# Post by @darasoba
## Post
Codex allows one provider at a time, but its requires_openai_auth flag will send your ChatGPT token to any URL. So I pointed it at a local Node proxy that routes deepseek-* requests to DeepSeek and everything else to [[https://chatgpt.com](https://chatgpt.com)](https://chatgpt.com/) then merged both model lists into a single catalog JSON.
